decision: Go to prepare a separate 0.2.0 version bump and release; rebuild and pass the tag-gated workflow after that bump.

findings.behavior: Package-managed mutations and unknown operations receive no automatic retries; explicitly read-only operations retain retries. Caller-supplied session policies remain caller-controlled.
Integer tokens outside the accelerated decoder exact range use standard decoding; plain JSON large-integer serialization round trips remain exact.
40 historical owned re-exports/module aliases/constants restored with lazy imports and canonical identities.
Version-independent project/runtime/archive/installed/docs checks passed at 0.1.8 and a temporary 0.2.0 copy.
Publication requires matching pushed tag/master ancestry, complete shared CI, clean matching commit and exact immutable artifact hashes. Manual validation passed with publication skipped.

limits: Import namespace/dependency declarations must change; no intermine namespace shim or Pandas behavior
460-symbol results are scoped assertions, with 127 documented tested departures; not exhaustive equivalence
Supplied sessions retain caller retry configuration
Live reads validated only on LegumeMine, MaizeMine and ThaleMine; OakMine/WheatMine returned anti-bot HTML
Authenticated live writes, private templates and complete datasets not exercised
Linux CPython 3.14.5 validated; Windows/macOS/free-threaded/later minors not certified
Estimated byte budgets are not strict RSS limits; one oversized page may proceed
Actual PyPI upload and external trusted-publisher configuration are deferred to the separately authorized release
